game.title: Singye Cham (Snow Lion Game)
game.description: A traditional performance-game where participants dress as snow lions and perform playful acrobatic movements, combining elements of dance, sport, and cultural ritual.
game.occasion: Tshechu festivals, religious ceremonies, special celebrations
howToPlay: Step 1: Performers dress in elaborate snow lion costumes.
Step 2: Two performers typically operate one lion costume (front and back).
Step 3: The lions perform playful movements, jumps, and acrobatics.
Step 4: They interact with the audience and other performers.
Step 5: Traditional music accompanies the performance.
Step 6: The game aspect involves chasing and playful competition between lions.
Step 7: Performances are part of larger festival celebrations.
Step 8: The snow lion is a national symbol of Bhutan.
Step 9: Skilled performers train extensively in coordination and movement.
Step 10: The tradition preserves Bhutanese cultural heritage.
